events.name: 1. FC Union Berlin at Bayer Leverkusen

headlines.description: Bayern Munich suffered their first setback of the new season when they were held to a goalless draw by newly promoted Schalke.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bayern falter as Karius earns draw for Schalke

headlines.description: Harry Kane scored the winner for Bayern Munich to claim a 2-1 win over SV Elversberg in the Bundesliga on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kane winner sees Bayern Munich beat Elversberg

events.name: 1. FC Union Berlin at Bayern Munich

headlines.description: Michael Olise scored his first Bayern Munich hat trick as the German champions romped to a 7-0 demolition of visiting Union Berlin in the Bundesliga on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Olise nets hat trick, Kane makes history in Bayern rout
